items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: He worked with me this past summer. I used him in my summer band

ctx.x: All he had to do was come down a half tone, which is what I was. Or what he could do was take the note that I left there and use it as the entrance note and come down a half tone to the right note on the next beat, which nothing could be easier than that.
What about some of the other people on the band. Frankie Socolow was on and off from day one almost.

That's the sweetheart of all times. That's the sweetest guy that was ever born, that ever lived; nicest person and a wonderful musician. He worked with me this past summer. I used him in my summer band and he left me the last week to go do the Jerry Lewis Telethon. He has nothing but compliments from me, as far as Frank Socolow is concerned. A wonderful
